questions.stem: A 20-year-old boy presented to the emergency department with H.R=110bpm, and BP=100/74. On examination, the abdomen was silent and rigid. Which among the following is true in the management of this patient?

options.label: A
options.text: X-ray abdomen is of no importance.

options.label: B
options.text: CECT is the investigation of choice.

options.label: C
options.text: Ultrasound-guided biopsy should be performed in this case.

options.label: D
options.text: Narcotics are contraindicated in this case.
